individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a set of pseudocoloured micrographs, not a plot; individual data point overlay is not applicable.

Panel B consists of line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time (with fitted model curves) and insets showing averaged early time-point traces; these are line/scatter-type plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-point overlay requirement, and the main traces already display individual measured time points.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A contains only micrographs, no error bars or box-plot elements.
FAIL - The insets display averaged early time-point responses with visible error bars, but the caption never states what the error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or number of replicates).
